scenario_1_donna_offensive_harvesting.GC0: Loaded Cut, then after-action Mezza; Donna downside is shed before the opponent acts.
scenario_1_donna_offensive_harvesting.GC1: Loaded Cut, no post-action switch; actor remains Donna through the opponent opportunity.
scenario_1_donna_offensive_harvesting.GC2: Loaded Cut, then after-action Mezza; immediate shedding remains legal.
scenario_1_donna_offensive_harvesting.GC3: Not behavior-tested; Italian dense interpretation would reproduce GC0 topology.

scenario_2_donna_just_in_time_entry.GC0: Mezza -> Donna before action -> Loaded Cut; actor must remain Donna afterward because the allowance was used.
scenario_2_donna_just_in_time_entry.GC1: Same as GC0: just-in-time entry remains, but post-benefit exposure is mandatory.
scenario_2_donna_just_in_time_entry.GC2: Cannot enter before action; establish Donna after an earlier activation, expose/telegraph for one opponent opportunity, then use Loaded Cut.

scenario_3_threatening_point_staging.GC0: Useful action -> Mezza after action -> point threat before opponent.
scenario_3_threatening_point_staging.GC1: No after-action acquisition; Mezza must be chosen before the useful action and retained.
scenario_3_threatening_point_staging.GC2: Useful action -> Mezza after action remains legal; defensive staging persists.

scenario_4_guard_gate_staging.GC0: Enter Tutta/Pflug after acting and hold the gate for the expected attack.
scenario_4_guard_gate_staging.GC1: Enter before the actor's useful action and remain through the expected attack.
scenario_4_guard_gate_staging.GC2: Enter after acting; immediate defensive staging remains legal.
scenario_4_guard_gate_staging.GC3: Action-produced movement is supportable, but free adjacency restriction is not.

scenario_5_a_b_a_loop.GC0: Donna benefit -> Mezza after -> Donna before next benefit: two-activation harvesting loop.
scenario_5_a_b_a_loop.GC1: Donna must remain through the opponent; a Donna-Mezza-Donna loop requires sacrificing an intervening offensive activation.
scenario_5_a_b_a_loop.GC2: Donna -> Mezza after; next activation cannot return before acting, so Donna benefit is delayed to a third activation.

scenario_6_open_recovery.GC0_GC1_GC2: Start-of-activation Open recovery consumes the voluntary allowance; no second before/after switch is legal.
scenario_6_open_recovery.GC3: Open -> any is an explicit experimental exception, not historical adjacency; it would bypass topology by design.
